slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist rate is 1-9″ or faster

note: PDR drive band spacing is .200″ (recommend two drive bands in the case neck for concentricity) Tip length: .143″. Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. form factor = .837. The product page also says: "This pure copper Hammer HBC™ is a true long-range hunting HAMMER! Fired from our 338 Fat Girl at 3230 fps with a standard atmosphere at 4000′ elevation, this 245gr Hammer HBC™ will carry 1800 fps to 1350 yards! You guys with long range 338 caliber hunting rigs that have barrel twist of 1-9″ or faster need to check these out. With their exceptional velocity potential and extremely high bc, nothing catches up to them to a very long range."
